items.title: Concrete threshold versus actual Gaussian bias

items.statement: The concrete threshold eventually lies below one quarter of the actual target Gaussian bias. 0\le\tau_{d,q}\le\min\!\left\{\frac12,\frac\beta4\right\}. Fix a positive real numerical scale \(C\), then \(0<\delta<1\). There is one natural cutoff \(d_0(C,\delta)\), chosen before all varying \(d,\kappa,q\). The cutoff is not asserted uniform over unbounded \(C\). For every natural \(d\ge d_0(C,\delta)\), real \(2\le\kappa\le d^{1-\delta}\), and natural \(q\ge0\) with \(q\le(\delta/256)\sqrt\kappa\log d\), put \(n=2q+1\). The exact integer query-cap regime includes \(q=0\); it is not an expected-cost statement. Use \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(\lambda_i=(\kappa+1)/2+(\kappa-1)\cos\theta_i/2\), \(\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_i)\), \(U\sim N(0,\Lambda^{-1})\), and \(Q(x)=\sum_i\cos(n\theta_i)x_i^2\). Set \(M=\mathbb E\|U\|^2\), \(b=\mathbb E Q(U)\), and \(\beta=|b|/M\). Lean uses the same grid with zero-based finite coordinates. The threshold is literal: \(\tau_{d,q}=C[(q+1)\sqrt{\log d/d}+(q+1)(q+1+\log d)\log d/d]\). All dimension, frequency, inverse-covariance, integrability, positivity and uniform-smallness conditions are established internally. This is a numerical auxiliary family for each fixed positive \(C\). The separate concentration argument must still produce one sufficiently large absolute \(C\), fixed before \(\delta\); specializing the family to that value then yields a \(\delta\)-only cutoff. No \(C\)-premise is added to either main lower bound.

bindings.boundary: Only the concrete numerical positive-C auxiliary family tau>=0,tau<=1/2,tau<=actual beta/4 and a PRIVATE actual shifted diagonal-Gaussian bad-event probability<=1/10 are proved locally. C is fixed before delta and cutoff; no concentration witness exists by this result and no C-premise is added to a main bound. Original graph v1 frequency-discharge/Markov-union HOLDs remain preserved and resolved only by independently accepted v2. The half-threshold implementation uses a sufficient actual-bias route; the private variance implementation uses centered Young, distinct from the source L2-triangle intermediate. Full limiting tau/beta statements, actual absolute-C concentration, rotated-law/polynomial detector, Krylov/Haar/adaptive algorithm histories, exact matvec/TV precision/deterministic worst-query-cap/expected-cost adapters, both main lower bounds and full source assembly remain open.
